plausibility_notes: Elon now admits removing his miniature bottle immediately beside Grant's glass while opening paperwork. In combination with the cyanide-contaminated anonymous miniature, this is the most specific surviving transfer opportunity.

Elon's final speech supplies no recoverable returned bottle, capped state, benign contents, or corroborated alternative use. His lead therefore depends substantially on a conspicuous narrative exception: almost every other speech supplies an explanatory artifact.
Al explicitly had uncapped favor and held empty target glass. A fragrance stain on invoice does not exclude cyanide added to that bottle or later to glass. He remains a real alternative.
Brie's wiping only stem/base is self-report. Neither packet return nor clean punch clears targeted glass poisoning; actual retained favor test would be stronger.
Justin put bottle on desk and capped it afterward, with fragrance stain. Like Al, this explains smell/spill but cannot show uncontaminated contents.

Hugh and Tess arriving after cabinet theft reduces direct theft opportunity if receipts are independently verified; does not eliminate receiving poison from another person or later using an already stolen bottle.
Anne being at education desk when toast served does not address glass's6:32–6:44 exposure window.

Most final explanations genuinely clear individual scandals' misleading interpretations, not the murder: unsigned legal documents, uncanceled claims and correction records do not remove physical opportunity.

Best current vote Elon, confidence moderate rather than decisive. No witness saw transfer and no uniquely identifying physical trace links contaminated favor to him. All witness statements could be selective or false absent a stated rule.
